output_inventory..clearSignal_timeline: empty directory created by the application timeline store at import
output_inventory..clearSignal_watchlist: empty directory created by the application watchlist store at import
output_inventory.isolated-home: empty HOME directory for the worker
output_inventory.ledger.sqlite: durable ledger: claims, wire entries, retained SEC response bodies with receipts, answers, failures, halts
output_inventory.ledger.sqlite-journal: transient SQLite rollback journal; absent after commit or parent rollback
output_inventory.packet.json: parent record of all twelve outcomes: the ledger export, or twelve not_run outcomes when the worker stopped before creating its ledger
output_inventory.request.json: launcher request: the bound policy (approval, references, case records, proxy/CA configuration); no runtime values
output_inventory.worker.json: worker report: counts, routing, pacing, diagnostics hash

derived.runtime_value_screening: retention and export refuse any record containing a runtime value
derived.source_content: public SEC EDGAR responses from www.sec.gov and data.sec.gov only
